Marta (CS): Heads-up: SilverHarbor reported intermittent latency tails after we moved a subset to int8 yesterday. p95 steady but p99 spikes during small bursts.
Evan (SRE): Noted. Any deployment/traffic changes besides the int8 trial?
Marta (CS): They increased context window for a feature flag; average tokens/request up ~25%.
Diego (ML): Int8 + longer contexts = higher KV cache churn and occasional kernel fallback on some GPUs. Could explain p99 spikes.
Evan (SRE): Quick mitigations: 1) enable prefix KV caching to reduce recomputation, 2) reduce max_batch_ms from 30 -> 15 for latency-sensitive routes, 3) add routing fallback to fp16 for requests > 512 tokens.
Marta (CS): Can you write a short routing/config they can apply? They'll want copy/paste.
Evan (SRE): Snippet to propose:
model: redwood/compact-int8-v2
routing:
  rules:
    - when: request.tokens > 512
      route_to: redwood/fp16-latency-opt
    - otherwise: use_model: redwood/compact-int8-v2
batching:
  max_batch_ms: 15
cache:
  prefix_kv_enabled: true
  max_prefix_entries: 4000
Diego (ML): Also recommend a 3% fp16 canary for 20 minutes and collect scalar outputs for the feature flag paths to detect any quantization regressions.
Marta (CS): Draft customer note: "Can you enable prefix KV caching and apply the small routing rule to send >512-token requests to fp16 for a short canary? We'll run a 20m fp16 canary at 10:10 PT and report back."
Evan (SRE): I'll schedule the canary and attach monitoring dashboards for p95/p99 and kv_hit_rate.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by @Evan (SRE) for silverharbor-prod routing override (job 9124).
Marta (CS): Thanks team. If p99 drops >40% we recommend keeping route rule permanent for long-context flows and leave int8 for short calls. I'll capture customer feedback and update renewal-risk notes if needed.
